description: Roman religious complex and settlement. The focus appears to have been ditched temenos within which a temple was present, the earliest of which is dated to the 1st CE. This temple would go through several phases of re-development, reaching its structural peak in the 3rd CE. Some time after this the superstructure appears to have been destroyed and there is some debate on how the structure was used, some suggesting that it was re-used as a domestic structure until the late 4th - early 5th CE. Production crafts also appear to have been prominent on the site.
